terrainDescription.zh: 阿爾卑斯山脈覆蓋西部與中部約六成國土，多瑙河谷與維也納盆地則是東部主要平原農業區。
terrainDescription.en: The Alps cover roughly 60% of the country across the west and center, while the Danube valley and Vienna Basin form the main lowland agricultural belt in the east.

plate.color: white background, black text; blue EU band with gold stars and country code "A" on the left; red-white-red tricolor bands top and bottom (since Nov 2002)

roadInfra.bollardStyle: White bollard with a black top and a small nipple-shaped black cap; dark red or dark grey reflector on the front — a highly distinctive combination not shared by any other country

utilityPole.transformerMount: Round wooden poles are the most common type

historicalContext.zh: 德語為官方語言，車牌自2002年11月起採用歐盟式設計（左側藍底歐盟星環+國碼A），但鄰國瑞士（非歐盟成員）則沒有此設計。
historicalContext.en: German is the official language; license plates have used the EU-style design (blue band with the EU stars and country code "A" on the left) since November 2002 — unlike neighboring Switzerland, which isn't an EU member and lacks this feature.
